1: Then I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.
2: And I said to the angel that talked with me, What [are] these? And he answered me, These [are] the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.
3: And the LORD showed me four carpenters.
4: Then said I, What come these to do? And he spoke, saying, These [are] the horns which have scattered Judah, so that no man lifted up his head: but these are come to terrify them, to cast down the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted [their] horn over the land of Judah to scatter it.
5: I lifted up my eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.
6: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said to me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what [is] its breadth, and what [is] its length.
7: And behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,
8: And said to him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited [as] towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle in it.
9: For I, saith the LORD, will be to her a wall of fire on every side, and will be the glory in the midst of her.
10: Ho, ho, [come forth], and flee from the land of the north, saith the LORD: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the LORD.
11: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest [with] the daughter of Babylon.
12: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me to the nations which wasted you: for he that toucheth you, toucheth the apple of his eye.
13: For behold, I will shake my hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me.
14: Sing, and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith the LORD.
15: And many nations shall be joined to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me to thee.
16: And the LORD shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.
17: Be silent, O all flesh, before the LORD: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.
